title: Normal Chip H4K16ac Control
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: After isolation, resuspend 1 × 10⁶ cells and add formaldehyde to a final concentration of 1 % (v/v). Incubate for 14 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Quench fixation with glycine
steps.instruction: Add glycine to a final concentration of 125 mM, mix, and incubate for 1 minute to quench the fixation.

steps.title: Wash cells and harvest
steps.instruction: Wash the cells three times with PBS containing complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, catalog 11836145001) and 10 mM sodium butyrate (Sigma‑Aldrich, catalog 303410). After the final wash, scrape the cells from the plates and collect the suspension.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei by Covaris
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell suspension to Covaris tubes and sonicate on the Covaris E220 for 4.5 minutes at peak power 75 W, duty factor 2 % and 200 cycles/burst to isolate nuclei.

steps.title: Perform immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: For each IP, use an equal amount of chromatin (quantified later) and add 2 µg of the specific antibody together with protein A/G Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific, catalog 88802). Follow the ChIP conditions described in Arrigoni 2018, omitting barcode ligation and pooling.

steps.title: Quantify chromatin concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the input chromatin using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Quantify immunoprecipitated DNA
steps.instruction: After IP and reverse cross‑linking, quantify the recovered DNA with a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific) before library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Construct sequencing libraries from the quantified DNA using the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit (New England BioLabs, catalog E7645S).

steps.title: Assess library quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate each library on a BioAnalyzer (Agilent) to determine fragment‑size distribution and concentration.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Sequence the prepared libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq instrument with 150 bp paired‑end reads.
